name: Fa Craft
description: Minecraft-like voxel sandbox with light survival — fully local, plays on macOS, iOS, Android and web.

cli.summary: Playable voxel sandbox: walk, break and place blocks, craft, survive falls, persistent world.

events.description: Select hotbar slot (payload {slot: 1-8}) or cycle when payload omitted
Start hold-to-mine (long press): breaks the targeted block and repeats every 280 ms until breakEnd
Place the selected block against the targeted face
Craft a recipe (payload {id}) or first recipe when omitted

read.state: jsr.exportState snapshot: pos, health, mode, selected, inventory, dayTime
